items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: like Chester Jones, drum player, and uh, Willie Santiago, guitar player.

ctx.x: Well, the most, did a lot of them leave town, or did most of them just stay here?
Yeah, all of them, that band moved and stood just. But the girls out of town come back, like Chester Jones, drum player, and uh, Willie Santiago, guitar player. Mm-hmm.
